reasoning_trace.value: The paper includes several figures and diagrams that illustrate the proposed system architecture, including a schematic geometry model of integrated ToF sensing and communication, a timing diagram of modulation and demodulation signals for a Hamiltonian coding scheme, a block diagram of the integrated depth sensing and communication system, and experimental setup photos.

reasoning_trace.description: Explain the System Mechanism and ISAC Coupling Mode found.
reasoning_trace.value: The system uses a Hamiltonian coding scheme to integrate ToF depth sensing and optical communication. The proposed system achieves a measurement accuracy of tens of millimeters and zero error code in communication, with a data rate of 20 Mbps. The system also uses a multi-frequency fusion algorithm to remove phase ambiguity and improve measurement precision.

reasoning_trace.description: Validate the physical consistency of reported metrics (Rate/Resolution).
reasoning_trace.value: The paper reports a depth error of 11.64 mm and a mean BER of nearly 0 for single-frequency modulation, and a depth error of 4.46 mm and a mean BER of nearly 0 for multi-frequency fusion. These results are physically consistent and demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed system.

reasoning_trace.description: Identify the solved problems and remaining open challenges.
reasoning_trace.value: The proposed system solves the problem of integrating ToF depth sensing and optical communication using a single waveform, and demonstrates a high measurement accuracy and low BER. However, the system still faces challenges such as phase ambiguity and limited measurement range, which are addressed using a multi-frequency fusion algorithm.
